payload.note: Dyadic stopping-flow theorem: the leading acyclic flow has total mass F. If F>2*q^2*N/W, more than F/2 crosses ratio-at-least-two edges, while any source-to-sink path contains at most D*log_2(W) such edges; hence ||div f||>=F/[D*log_2(W)*sqrt(N)]. The complete-current error is absorbed under sqrt(W)>=16*sqrt(q)*D*log_2(W), giving Q>=q^2/[D^2*log_2(W)^2]. The complementary sparse branch uses the top-band theorem. Thus on T_L^4 for L>=4096, W>=512*L^(10/3) implies Q/omega_L^2>=32/pi^4. The all-field sub-L^(10/3), Witten/H^-1, continuum, Born/Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
